subject: Covasys renewal: token trajectories, SKU alignment & 2027 commit proposal
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@covasys.ai>
To: dylan brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@covasys.ai>, renewals <renewals@covasys.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q4 usage & renewal planning — health check request

Hi Dylan,

Hope you’re well. We’re starting our internal renewal planning and need a short health/usage review for Covasys so we can present a recommended commit to finance next week. Specifically: token consumption trends (Q4–Q1), latency/regression flags, and any recommended SKU/commit levels for 2027 based on our growth forecast.

Can Redwood provide a 1-page summary and the raw token-by-route export? If possible, include suggested autoscale/burst settings that would keep our 95th percentile latency under 250ms while lowering cost per token.

We’d like to review on Thursday (2/12) or Friday (2/13). Tom and I are available after 10am PT.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Lim
Head of Platform
Covasys

From: dylan brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@covasys.ai>
Cc: vanessa ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, marissa cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Q4 usage & renewal planning — health check request

Hi Sara — thanks for the note.

We can absolutely put that together. Vanessa will assemble the performance summary and Marissa will pull the token export and cost overlays.

Thursday 2/12 at 10:30am PT works for Redwood. Proposed agenda:
- 10m: Q4→Q1 token trends and cost per route
- 10m: latency & SLA flags (95th percentile analysis)
- 10m: recommended commit tiers + SKU alignment for 2027
- 5m: mutual action plan / timeline to sign

Attachments we’ll bring: a short one-pager and the raw token-by-route CSV.

See you then — I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Dylan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: vanessa ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: dylan brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, marissa cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: sergio alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Draft: Covasys health one-pager + notes

Team — attaching a draft one-pager summary (covasys_q4_token_report.pdf) and the proposed pricing grid. Key highlights:
- Net token trend: +38% QoQ overall; chat routes drove 62% of the increase.
- Cost per 1k tokens: effective $0.85 (after caching improvements in Jan).
- Latency: overall P95 = 220ms; two routes ("inference-chat-long" and "batch-embeds") hit spikes during peak windows (02/03 10:00–11:30 PT).
- Recommendation: move Covasys from "Standard" SKU to "Committed-1" with a 20% uplift in reserved tokens and a 30% discount on dedicated burst blocks. This preserves P95 targets with predicted unit cost savings of ~12% vs. pay-as-you-go for their forecasted growth.

Open questions for finance: acceptable minimum commit term (12 vs 24 months) and preferred billing cadence.

Attachments: covasys_q4_token_report.pdf, proposed_pricing_grid_2027.csv

— Vanessa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Becker <tom.becker@covasys.ai>
To: dylan brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, vanessa ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@covasys.ai>, renewals <renewals@covasys.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Q4 usage & renewal planning — health check request

Thanks — the summary looks good. A couple quick clarifying items before the call:
- Can you share the raw token export for our internal finance model (csv)?
- The latency spikes — were those correlated with a specific model version or a transient batch job? If model version, we need a mitigation path.

We prefer a 12-month committed term but would consider 24 months for a larger discount. Also curious whether you can bake in an SLO credit if latency exceeds 300ms in a billing month.

Tom
Director of Engineering
Covasys

From: marissa cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Becker <tom.becker@covasys.ai>, dylan brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, vanessa ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: sergio alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, sara lim <sara.lim@covasys.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 13:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Q4 usage & renewal planning — health check request

Tom — attached is the raw export (rdw_mutual_action_plan_covasys.xlsx includes the token-by-route CSV tab) and a short notes tab mapping the latency spikes to a scheduled long-context batch run on 02/03 (job id: batch-ctx-2287). That job coincided with a backfill for a training job — not a model regression.

On SLO credits: Redwood can include a 2-tier SLO credit for latency breaches. Proposal (high level):
- If monthly P95 > 300ms for a route for > 3 hours total: 5% billing credit for that month (up to 2x per year).
- If monthly P95 > 400ms for a route for > 1 hour: 15% billing credit + automatic parallel reroute to fallback model.

I’m also attaching the proposed MAP for sign-off. If Covasys is comfortable with the pricing grid, I can draft a commit amendment and push to DocuSign.

Attachments: rdw_mutual_action_plan_covasys.xlsx, proposed_pricing_grid_2027.csv

— Marissa
Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Subject: Covasys 2027 commit proposal + next steps

Key artifacts attached: covasys_q4_token_report.pdf (one-page summary), rdw_mutual_action_plan_covasys.xlsx (MAP + raw export), proposed_pricing_grid_2027.csv

SLO credit schedule (as discussed):
- P95 > 300ms for a route >3 hours/month => 5% credit (limit 2x/year)
- P95 > 400ms for a route >1 hour/month => 15% credit + automatic fallback

Proposed timeline:
- Fri 2/13: Covasys sign-off on MAP and pricing grid (or provide redlines)
- Mon 2/16: Redwood issues amendment and DocuSign link
- Wed 2/25: New committed tier goes live (subject to payment)

Ask: please confirm whether Covasys prefers a 12- or 24-month term and whether the billing cadence should be monthly or quarterly. I’ve opened a HubSpot deal and added the proposal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/78910. If you’re good, I’ll enqueue the amendment for DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/XYZ-DOCKET-4521

Best,
